title: Section adjunction detects equality
statement: For sectionAdjoint of [def-sfb-tower-class-section-adjoint], if two ordinary arrows pull(M) to N have equal sectionAdjoint values for every n, chart U, and source section x, then the arrows are equal.

source.place: paragraph (1), sectionwise ordinary adjunction used in the twisted unit square

proof.text: The ordinary adjunction homEquiv is injective. Test the transposed maps of sheaves on every section at every object (n,U) of the sequence site. Postcompose by the component of the invertible ordinaryPushEvaluation comparison; its section map is injective, with inverse the inverse isomorphism. The assumed equality is exactly the resulting equality of sections.
